name: random-wheel
description: <用户自制> 随机转盘：把截图或选项做成可调速的动画转盘，随机抽选。 Turn screenshot choices or named options into a speed-adjustable animated wheel with equal-probability random selection.

interface.longDescription: Turn screenshot choices or named options into a speed-adjustable animated wheel with equal-probability random selection. For Codex users; includes the complete Skill and its supporting resources. Uses the recipient's available tools and environment. External tools, accounts, and services are not provisioned by installation.
